# tapo-mcp — Full Reference

## Overview

FastMCP 3.4+ server for TP-Link Tapo devices: cameras (PTZ, snapshot, streaming)
and smart plugs (power toggle, energy monitoring). SQLite time-series for plug data.

### Architecture

```
MCP Client -> FastMCP Server -> pytapo / tapo lib -> Tapo cloud API / LAN
                 |
            FastAPI (web_app.py)
           /              \
     SQLite (plugs)     Vite React SPA
```

### Dependencies

Drivers are core deps: `tapo` (smart plugs) + `pytapo` (cameras) installed on `uv sync`.

### Storage

Plug energy data in SQLite (`data/timeseries.db`). Camera state is ephemeral.

### Env vars

| Variable | Required | Default | Description |
|----------|----------|---------|-------------|
| `TAPO_CLOUD_EMAIL` | Plugs | — | Tapo cloud account email |
| `TAPO_CLOUD_PASSWORD` | Plugs | — | Tapo cloud account password |
| `TAPO_CAMERA_HOST` | Cameras | — | Camera IP/hostname |
| `TAPO_CAMERA_USERNAME` | No | admin | Camera username |
| `TAPO_CAMERA_PASSWORD` | Cameras | — | Camera password |

## Tools

### tapo_plug

Operations: list, status, toggle, energy_history

### tapo_camera

Operations: list, status, snapshot, ptz, privacy_mode, led, stream

### tapo_register_camera

Register a camera by host/username/password.

## REST API

| Method | Path | Description |
|--------|------|-------------|
| GET | /api/health | Health check |
| GET | /api/v1/diagnostics | Diagnostics (CUA gate) |
| GET | /api/plugs | List plugs |
| GET | /api/plugs/{id} | Plug details + current power |
| POST | /api/plugs/{id}/toggle | Power on/off |
| GET | /api/plugs/{id}/history | Energy time-series |
| GET | /api/cameras | List cameras |
| GET | /api/cameras/{id} | Camera status |
| GET | /api/cameras/{id}/snapshot | JPEG snapshot |
| POST | /api/cameras/{id}/ptz | PTZ move |
| POST | /api/cameras/{id}/privacy_mode | Toggle privacy |
| POST | /api/cameras/{id}/led | Toggle LED |
| GET | /api/cameras/{id}/stream | Stream URL |
